question: Sweden Parliamentary Election: M Vote Share?
resolution_criteria:
Parliamentary elections are scheduled to be held in Sweden on September 13, 2026.

This market will resolve according to the percentage of valid votes received by Moderate Party (M) in the specified election.

If the reported value falls exactly between two brackets, then this market will resolve to the higher range bracket.

This market will resolve solely based on the percentage of valid votes won by the specified party, defined as the number of valid votes won by the specified party divided by the total number of valid votes in the specified election.

Valid vote percentages will be counted only where the Swedish Election Authority attributes them to the aforementioned party. Vote percentages attributed to other parties or electoral designations will not count, regardless of electoral cooperation, endorsements, coalition agreements, or subsequent parliamentary-group arrangements. If the specified party formally merges into a successor party before the election and does not contest separately, the valid vote percentage of the successor party will count towards resolution.

If the results of this election are not definitively known by December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to the lowest range bracket.

This market will resolve based on the results of this election as indicated by a consensus of credible reporting. If there is ambiguity, this market will resolve based solely on the official results as reported by the Swedish government, specifically the Swedish Election Authority (Valmyndigheten) (https://www.val.se/).
research:
I've finished searching and am writing up the findings. In polls published by about 2026-08-19, the Moderates were at roughly 16.8% to 18.4%, well inside the 16-18% and 18-20% brackets. I ignored everything I came across dated after 2026-08-25.

## 1. Resolution source
- The deciding source is Valmyndigheten's official count at [val.se](https://www.val.se/): M's valid votes divided by all valid votes. The election is on 2026-09-13, so there was no result as of 2026-08-25. I did not fetch val.se because it would only show the 2022 results or nothing for 2026.
- For context, M got about 19.1% in 2022 (Verian also calls current polling "significantly below 2022"). [Verian](https://www.veriangroup.com/sv/news-and-insights/valjarbarometer-augusti-2026)

## 2. Current status
- Nothing has settled the question yet. Polls put M on the line between the 16-18% and 18-20% brackets. No pollster I found had M at or above 20%, or below 16%, in August.

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-08-24/25 (fieldwork end dates; publication may be after the cutoff): Polara's tracker lists Demoskop at 17.2% and 16.6%. I can't confirm these were published by 2026-08-25. [Polara](https://polara.se/opinion/augusti-2026)
- About 2026-08-20 (fieldwork end): Polara lists a second Verian poll at 16.4%. Publication date unconfirmed. [Polara](https://polara.se/opinion/augusti-2026)
- About 2026-08-18 (fieldwork end): Indikator Opinion had M at 18.4%. Exact publication date unknown. [Polara](https://polara.se/opinion/augusti-2026)
- 2026-08-19: Novus/TV4 (fieldwork Aug 3-16): M 18.3% (+1.0), SD 19.1%, S 30.1%, KD 6.3%, L 1.9%. The opposition leads the Tidö parties 52.5% to 45.6%. [Placera](https://www.placera.se/telegram/valbarometer-l-fortsatt-klart-under-sparren--novus-tv4-20260819)
- 2026-08-18: Verian/SVT (fieldwork Aug 3-16, n=3,043): M 17.3%, the "fifth poll in a row around 17%". The report says high media visibility on tougher sentencing has had no clear effect so far. SD 18.5%, C 8.0%, KD 6.2%, L 1.9%. [Verian](https://www.veriangroup.com/sv/news-and-insights/valjarbarometer-augusti-2026)
- 2026-08-12: Demoskop: M 16.8%, SD 20.2%. [hurbra.se](https://hurbra.se/opinionsmatningar-valet-2026-19-augusti/)
- July 2026: Novus/TV4 had M at about 17.3% (+0.7), described as "M ökar". [Placera July](https://www.placera.se/telegram/valbarometer-m-okar-l-pa-historiskt-lag-niva--novus-tv4-20260722)
- Polara's average for July was about 17.1%. Its August average of 17.7% (+0.6) includes some polls from after the cutoff. [Polara](https://polara.se/opinion/augusti-2026)
- I could not verify a DN/Ipsos August figure from a source dated before the cutoff.

## 4. Base rates
- Past M results, from memory, not checked this session: 2010 30.1%, 2014 23.3%, 2018 19.8%, 2022 19.1%. The trend is downward but has levelled off near 19-20%.
- Polling error, from memory and unverified: in 2018 M beat its final polling averages (about 17-18%) by roughly 2 points. In 2022 the final polls were close to the result. A miss of about 1-2 points for a large Swedish party is typical.
- Over roughly three weeks, August polls ranged about 16.4-18.9%, a spread of 2.5 points between pollsters. Movement within a single pollster was about ±1 point per month.
- Pollsters differ systematically: Indikator and Novus run high for M (about 18-19%), while Demoskop and Verian run low (about 16.5-17.3%).

## 5. Other forecasts
- Polymarket has a market called "Sweden Parliamentary Election: M Vote Share?" (event 502873; PredScope lists it as created 2026-08-12). I could not find its bracket prices as of 2026-08-25. The only snapshots I found were dated after the cutoff, so I left them out. [PredScope](https://predscope.com/event/sweden-parliamentary-election-m-vote-share-20260812172636430), [Polymarket](https://polymarket.com/event/502873)
- An undated aggregator summary says SD is "consistently placing second at roughly 19%" against M at 17-18% in final averages. [lines.com](https://www.lines.com/prediction-markets/elections/sweden-parliamentary-election-winner)
- I found no expert or academic vote-share forecast for M.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- More polls are due in the final weeks: Indikator, Demoskop, Novus, Verian, DN/Ipsos, and probably daily or rolling polls close to election day.
- Party leader debates on SVT and TV4 and the final campaign stretch, where M is pushing crime and sentencing.
- Tactical voting: L is polling at 1.9%, below the 4% threshold. Coalition-minded voters may move between M, KD and L, which could shift M by a point or so either way.
- Election day is 2026-09-13. Preliminary results come that night and Valmyndigheten's final count follows within days, around the 2026-09-19 resolution date.
